summary: The open AI model ecosystem spans massive model repositories and developer-facing inference APIs. Hugging Face dominates as the central hub, having surpassed 3 million public models by August 2026, with China recently overtaking the U.S. in monthly downloads; notably, roughly half of all models have fewer than 200 downloads while the top 200 models account for nearly half of all download traffic. Alongside hosting, a cluster of inference platforms (Ollama, Replicate, Together AI, Fireworks AI, SiliconFlow, and others) make these open weights easy to run locally or via serverless pay-per-token APIs.

platforms.name: Hugging Face
platforms.purpose: The largest open hub for hosting, sharing, and discovering AI models, datasets, and demo Spaces, with hosted inference options.
platforms.pricing: Free hosting for public repos; Pro ~$9/mo; Inference Endpoints and serverless Inference priced per compute/usage; Enterprise plans available
features: Transformers, Diffusers, and other open libraries
Serverless Inference API and dedicated Inference Endpoints
Community collaboration, model cards, and Git-based versioning
platforms.best_for: Researchers, ML engineers, and developers who need the broadest model selection and open tooling.

platforms.name: Ollama
platforms.purpose: A tool for running open-weight LLMs locally on your own machine with a simple CLI and API.
platforms.model_count: Hundreds of curated models in its library (Llama, Mistral, Qwen, Gemma, DeepSeek, Phi, etc.)
platforms.pricing: Free and open source (self-hosted); you provide the hardware
features: One-line local model pulls and runs
Local REST API compatible with OpenAI format
GGUF quantized model support for consumer hardware
platforms.best_for: Developers and privacy-conscious users wanting to run models locally without cloud costs.

platforms.name: Replicate
platforms.purpose: A cloud platform to run and deploy open-source models via API without managing infrastructure.
platforms.model_count: Thousands of community and official models across text, image, video, and audio
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-second of compute (varies by GPU type); no flat subscription
features: Run models via simple API calls
Cog packaging for custom model deployment
Supports image, video, audio, and language models
platforms.best_for: App developers who want to integrate diverse open models (especially multimodal) via API with minimal ops.

platforms.name: Together AI
platforms.purpose: A developer inference and fine-tuning cloud optimized for fast, scalable serving of open LLMs.
platforms.model_count: 200+ open models (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mixtral, FLUX, etc.)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token for inference; per-GPU-hour for dedicated endpoints; fine-tuning priced per token
platforms.best_for: Developers and startups building production LLM apps that need speed, scale, and fine-tuning on open models.

platforms.name: Fireworks AI
platforms.purpose: A high-performance inference platform for serving open and fine-tuned generative models at low latency.
platforms.model_count: 100+ curated open models (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mixtral, FLUX, etc.)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token for serverless; per-GPU-hour for dedicated deployments; fine-tuning available
features: LoRA fine-tuning and custom model serving
platforms.best_for: Teams needing the lowest-latency, high-throughput production inference for open models.

platforms.name: SiliconFlow
platforms.purpose: A cost-efficient inference cloud (strong in the China market) serving a wide range of open LLMs and multimodal models.
platforms.model_count: 100+ open models (Qwen, DeepSeek, GLM, Llama, FLUX, Kolors, etc.)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token, competitively low pricing; some models offered free-tier
features: Strong support for Chinese open models (Qwen, DeepSeek, GLM)
Text, image, audio, and video generation
platforms.best_for: Developers (especially in Asia) seeking low-cost access to Chinese and global open models.

platforms.name: Groq
platforms.purpose: An ultra-low-latency inference platform using custom LPU hardware to serve open LLMs at extreme speed.
platforms.model_count: Dozens of open models (Llama, Qwen, Mixtral, Gemma, DeepSeek distill, etc.)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token; competitive rates with a free developer tier
platforms.best_for: Developers needing the fastest real-time inference for chat and agentic applications.

platforms.name: OpenRouter
platforms.purpose: A unified API gateway that routes requests across many open and closed model providers through one endpoint.
platforms.model_count: 300+ models from dozens of providers (open and proprietary)
platforms.pricing: Pass-through per-token pricing with a small markup; pay-as-you-go credits
features: Single OpenAI-compatible API for many providers
Price and latency comparison across providers
Access to both open-weight and frontier closed models
platforms.best_for: Developers who want flexible, provider-agnostic access to a broad model catalog through one API.
